meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 WhatsApp 收发消息。绑定手机需扫码或配对码;它会按共享或专用号码规则决定谁能和它对话。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 WhatsApp、添加该渠道时触发,随后会引导选择号码类型和绑定方式。

say.note: 生成二维码供手机扫描

say.text: 我用自己的号码,明白风险,继续

howto.what_en: Adds WhatsApp support so Claude can chat there. Requires linking with QR code or pairing code, then behaves per shared/dedicated number mode.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to connect/add WhatsApp, then leads you through number-type choice and QR/pairing link.

say_en.note: Starts the install and linking flow.

say_en.text: Connect my WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: Shows a QR code to scan with your phone.

say_en.text: I'll use my shared number and accept the risk, continue
